Name: Fairy light
Author: SapiensTraaveler
Description:
Hi! I'm not the biggest modder out there, and I don't always feel like I've earned the title, but I genuinely love making mods for this game, and it means a lot that you're here.

I do have one very specific request: I'm trying to cover my internet bill, which is about $20 a month. If you enjoy my mods and want to chip in, you can leave a donation below. Any amount helps, even a single cent, and I'll be grateful either way.

Thank you so much for playing my mods and for your support! 

PayPal:[url=https://paypal.me/SapiensTraveler]https://paypal.me/SapiensTraveler[/url]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53250/53250-1790902523-1084218743.png[/img]

This mod adds a little fairy to the Mines. You can find her on Floor 3: just break rocks, and there's a chance she'll appear. She might show up on the very first rock or the last one, so it's all down to luck!

Once you find her, you'll unlock the recipe for a [b]bell[/b], which you can craft with one Gold Bar. Use the bell to send the fairy home whenever she's in the way, and call her back whenever you like.

She's a cute little pet that follows you around and gives off a soft light.

[b]Future plans:[/b] I'd like to add different types of fairies and light colors in a future update, but my internet situation makes that hard right now.
Thanks for trying my mod, I hope you enjoy it!

Manifest.Name: Sapiens Fairy
Manifest.Description: A small fairy that follows you and lights the way.
